name: Greenleaf
_turns: How many turns a game lasts (the arena doc); the turn track at the table's end has a slot for each.
_grid: One character per tile, row 0 = the far side (player 2), last row = player 1's side. Each character is defined in the legend. From a photo of the user's drawn board (mapstomake/greenleaf.webp, perspective-straightened): a garden lawn split up by hedges two levels tall, a creek one level down with the grass bridge over it, four flags, four traps, four pairs of secret passages and three flowers that fling a Pokemon to one of their three numbered spots.
_legend: level = height step (the lawn is level 1, the creek level 0); tiles interact only within 1 level. surface picks the look from the palette. solid = nothing can stand on or cross it (no snap point). lines: false = no slab lines (hedges, water). marker = something on the tile (painted, or a 3D piece with piece: true). = = the creek; bridge: grass = the grass bridge over it, two halves that grow out of the hedges either side of the creek to meet in the middle (each half carries its tiles' snap points while open; they start closed, inside the hedges). 1-4 = secret passages, both ends of a pair the same colour (palette passage<n>) and number. R/B/V = the red, blue and violet flowers (a flat 3D bloom carrying the tile's snap point); u/v/w, i/j/k, x/y/z = their spots 1-3 (painted in the flower's colour, palette flower-<name>). T = traps (right-click > Spring trap removes one once used).
_board: The published board files the map picker uses (from tools/build_board.py; update when a new version is published), then run tools/build_arena_index.py.
_table: Image for the table around the board (placeholder until the arena gets its own).
_textures: Placeholders from tools/draw_placeholders.py: lawn, clipped hedge tops and sides (the sides fitted from the lawn up to the hedge tops; outer: on the board's edge too), creek water, garden soil for the creek's banks and the board's edge.
